input_summary: Human Authority approved the SubscriptionSweep Apple Trial Guard design and authorized progression into canonical specification and implementation planning.

checks.name: Canon capability and project resolution
checks.detail: The request maps to the existing SubscriptionSweep concept and reusable RenewalLens reminder/renewal capability family.

checks.name: BuildGraph reuse and duplication screen
checks.detail: EXTEND_EXISTING is selected. A dedicated implementation namespace is justified because no implementation repository exists.

checks.name: Human Authority and action boundary
checks.detail: The user explicitly approved the design. Reversible specification and planning writes are authorized; credentials, live billing, deployment, signing, and submission remain gated.

checks.name: Apple API feasibility boundary
checks.detail: The design does not claim universal Apple Account subscription access. Detection uses permitted source ingestion and cancellation uses Apple's native management interface.

checks.name: Sensitive data handling
checks.detail: Mailbox and receipt data are confidential. The design requires read-minimized access, token encryption, source minimization, deletion controls, and untrusted-content handling.

checks.name: External credentials and irreversible actions
checks.detail: Apple signing, mailbox OAuth, production deployment, live billing, and App Store submission cannot be verified until credentials and explicit release authority are supplied.

notes: No production capability claim is permitted from design artifacts alone.
Implementation must preserve VERIFIED, INFERRED, and NEEDS_CONFIRMATION evidence states.
The next gate is review of the committed written specification.
